partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-BROWSER-INDEX-001: Content kind of a file from its lowercase extension, for the listed extensions only; listing excluded
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-BROWSER-INDEX-003: Only a sidecar whose parent folder is named exactly Ableton Folder Info is read; the user-folder sidecar name in F's sidecar folder is read and describes files directly inside F
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-BROWSER-INDEX-004: Folder-resource sidecar form of the fixtures; informational xmp properties ignored; a sidecar that is not well-formed gives no tags or labels
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-BROWSER-INDEX-005: An entry whose filePath is exactly the name of a file directly inside F applies to that file; an entry naming nothing does not affect other entries
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-BROWSER-INDEX-006: keywords entries give tags; colors entries 1 to 7 give labels, 0, 8 and empty entries are ignored; written encoding
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-BROWSER-INDEX-007: User-folder sidecar name, location and data model of a new sidecar for an item directly in F; override file names for the Core Library and built-in content; timing and the override folder excluded
partial_requirement_scopes.REQ-BROWSER-INDEX-008: A folder copied with its sidecar folder keeps its tags when added on another installation

compatibility_dimensions.file-classification: static-derived expectations; reference execution not-run; observation channel to be designed

sidecar folders with another letter case; sidecar folders below F; files with any other name in F's sidecar folder; any other location of a sidecar; user folders inside the User Library

a resource, format or platform other than folder, application/vnd.ableton.folder and mac

a filePath that differs from an item only in letter case, absolute paths, . or .. levels, \ separators, or a trailing /; a filePath that contains / or names a folder; the tags and labels of items inside a subfolder of F
color entries other than exactly 1 to 7, 0, 8 or empty; keyword entries that are empty, repeated, of one level, or of four or more levels; leading or trailing spaces in any value
the tags and labels of items inside a tagged folder; more than one sidecar for the same folder
edits to items inside a subfolder of F; edits when F already has a sidecar folder; edits that leave an item with no tags and no labels; read-only volumes; a missing User Library
inputs that combine conditions this release excludes

how tags and color labels are presented, grouped, searched or filtered
when a sidecar is written after an edit, any batching, and what happens on quit

messages, logs and dialogs, undo, progress and timing

fixture_origin: independently authored minimal WAV files and sidecar texts from one template; no shipped file content or program code

reviewers: separate review agent (Claude Opus 5.5) in a coordinator-launched handoff-review context; not the author; will not implement
findings: RVB-01 high: cases 016 and 017 expected tags from entries naming a file in a subfolder and a folder; the reviewer's static check shows a user folder's sidecar applies only to files directly inside the folder, by name; both cases removed, REQ-005 clause 1 and REQ-003 clause 2 narrowed, inputs excluded

RVB-02 low: an entry naming no file is never applied, and the application then treats the sidecar as changed without it; whether it rewrites the file is untraced; excluded behavior added; the no-interference assumption is now supported and removed from the assumption list

RVB-03 low: observation obligations did not say that absence from a view is not an observation; clarified, and an item not presented or offered makes the comparison inconclusive; no expectation changed
RVB-04 editorial: the factory and built-in cases now state how 'no sidecar written inside' is compared
RVB-05 editorial: payload status wording set to reviewed release; review record added; inventory re-hashed
RVB-06 info: colour entry rule re-derived from the retained evidence and the pinned build; only exactly 1 to 7, 0, 8 and empty are graded; cases 019 to 021 confirmed
RVB-07 info: written-sidecar comparison is by data model and tolerates extra item fields, empty bags, informational properties and any serialization; confirmed for cases 023 to 025
RVB-08 info: kind table, four sidecar names and evidence identity re-checked independently; all matched
RVB-09 info: remaining stated assumptions accepted with reasons; no expectation invented
RVB-10 info: fixture and sharing review; 26 authored fixture files, no shipped content; acceptable
RVB-11 info: scope rulings; kind table without a listing claim, override names, ten new cases and the exclusion in place of the two planned reference observations accepted
review.disposition: Approved with listed narrowing (RVB-01, RVB-02), only for the explicit partial clauses; 26 cases; expectations static-derived; reference and candidate execution not-run; restricted implementation workspace required
